title: uuencoding: serde feature declared but never applied to any public type
description: Cargo.toml declares a 'serde' feature that enables serde/derive. No public type (BlockMetadata, DecodedBlock, ScannedBlock, UuError) has cfg_attr(feature=serde, derive) guards. Enabling the feature compiles serde in but provides zero serialization capability. Either add derives to the four public types or remove the dead feature.
